candidates.passage: Every weekday for eleven years Oksana had weighed out flour at the same bench before dawn. Now her hands stopped the scoop at four hundred grams without a glance at the scale. A new radio played on the shelf. She tied her apron and called for the trays.
candidates.question: Oksana takes a desk job for two years and never weighs flour. Going only by the passage, which of these has most likely faded when she comes back?
candidates.right: stopping the scoop without a glance
wrong: tying her apron at the bench
hearing the radio on the shelf
